section_3.description: Designed for mature students looking to enter cybersecurity, network engineering, and systems security. Study while maintaining your weekly schedule.

cards.description: Tech enthusiasts, career changers looking for a future-proof job, and professionals in IT looking to certify their skills. Blends theory with hands-on virtual lab training.

cards.title: What you'll learn
cards.description: System architecture, penetration testing, database management, network security, ethical hacking, threat analysis, and Python scripting.

cards.title: Assessment style
cards.description: Primarily project-based assessments and practical lab simulations with few traditional memory-based exams. Highly focused on building real portfolios.

section_15.title: Questions before applying.
section_15.description: Clear answers reduce uncertainty before you apply.

faqs.question: Do I need coding experience?
faqs.answer: No. The course begins with computing principles and coding basics from scratch.

faqs.question: Can I get Student Finance?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you meet the personal eligibility criteria, both tuition fees and maintenance loans are available.

faqs.question: Are there many practical exams?
faqs.answer: The assessments focus mostly on building configurations, threat analysis reports, and network designs rather than memorised exams.
